LanguageData.aome.label: Sheep Beast Horn Aome
LanguageData.aome.description:
She is a maid apprentice in Hana's mansion. She is a solid person unlike her sister Akame. She has a transmitter attached to Akame and knows her sister's position. If a fool would hurt her big sister, she would be sanctioned.
During battle, she fights with her own stuffed toy "Kumagoro".
